items.title: John Abercrombie interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 19, 2001
items.q: there’s this wonderful oud player named Anouar Brahem

ctx.x: But then when you find musicians, I think especially more and more now you find European musicians who go back to their roots, go back to the music of their country, they try to incorporate the music of Norway or Sweden or wherever they happen to be coming from, I mean, into jazz. And then you have other people that record for ECM that I mean there’s this wonderful oud player named Anouar Brahem, I’m not sure if I’m pronouncing it right, but he doesn’t play jazz at all, he plays oud. But he improvises you know.…
How much has the changing technology allowed you or helped you to do some of that, to go in those different directions?
